claims: Early 2027 Social Security COLA forecasts project a 2.8% increase matching the anticipated 2026 adjustment.
Some estimates for the 2027 Social Security COLA range between 1.7% and 3.2%.
The Senior Citizens League predicted a 2.8% increase for the 2027 Social Security COLA.
Some forecasts estimate a range from 1.7% to 3.2% for the 2027 Social Security COLA.
The official 2027 Social Security COLA will be announced in October 2026.
The official 2027 Social Security COLA will be based on the third quarter (July, August, September) inflation data.
The 2027 Social Security COLA will take effect for payments in January 2027.
The Social Security COLA is calculated using the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers (CPI-W).
Analysts suggest that global tensions and energy prices are major factors in shaping the 2027 Social Security COLA.
